name: Bottle of Zombie Juice
summary: In Darkshire, Bottle of Zombie Juice is bound for Abercrombie, a reclusive hermit in Duskwood. He says the potent liquor, brewed from rot blossom, keeps him warm.

sections.title: A Pungent Concoction
sections.body: Rot blossoms gathered in Duskwood go into this harsh brew. The bartender in Darkshire warns it is potent enough to raise the dead. Most folk want nothing to do with such a vile drink. Yet Abercrombie, an eccentric hermit, says it alone keeps him warm on cold, damp nights by his lonely shack.

sections.title: Questionable Thirst
sections.body: Abercrombie calls the liquor a fiery nightcap. When he receives the bottle, he nearly praises the courier’s foolishness instead of their kindness. What use could he have for a drink so potent?

faq.q: What is Zombie Juice made from?
faq.answer: Zombie Juice is distilled from rot blossoms, a foul-smelling plant found in Duskwood’s corrupted soil.
Abercrombie wants the bottle delivered to his solitary shack along Duskwood’s western borders.

faq.q: Why does Abercrombie want Zombie Juice?
faq.answer: Abercrombie claims the fiery drink keeps his old bones warm through Duskwood’s bitter, dark nights. His strange manner suggests he may have another use for so potent a brew.

faq.q: Can players drink the Bottle of Zombie Juice?
faq.answer: No. You must carry the bottle safely to Abercrombie’s shack for delivery.

angles.text: Herbalists familiar with Duskwood know rot blossom is unfit for ordinary restorative tonics. Its use in a drink is unsettling.
Errands between Darkshire and the shadowed wilderness connect Duskwood’s troubled inhabitants, even when the work seems dubious.
